absent_brands.finding: No traditional unitized top-load laundry center on samsung.com as of 2026-08-07; its single-unit stacked offering is the front-load Bespoke AI Laundry Hub.
No traditional unitized laundry center on lg.com as of 2026-08-07; LG's entries are single-unit front-load WashTowers (27-in vented, 27-in heat-pump WKHC252H, 24-in WKHC152H).

No laundry center on maytag.com as of 2026-08-07 — 'Stackable Washers and Dryers' page covers stackable pairs. Lowe's retains legacy stacked-laundry-center product pages (very old IDs); current purchasability unverified. Maytag Commercial sells coin/commercial stack units.
No laundry center found on amana.com or in retailer searches as of 2026-08-07 — only top-load washer + dryer pairs.
No laundry center found in Hotpoint listings at Lowe's/Home Depot/hotpoint.com as of 2026-08-07 — pairs only.
No unitized laundry center as of 2026-08-07 — only washer/dryer pairs via rent-to-own dealers. (Crosley itself DOES sell the GE-built XUD27 laundry centers.)
No currently-sold unitized laundry center as of 2026-08-07; legacy models appear only as Sears PartsDirect parts listings; current products are all-in-one combos.
No laundry center as of 2026-08-07 — only a stacking rack stand for its portable units.
No unitized laundry center as of 2026-08-07 — sells 24-in all-in-one combos (SPWD2202W/SPWD2203P) and a stackable washer + heat-pump dryer PAIR (SLS24W3P).

Despite a Home Depot 'Equator Laundry Centers' category, Equator's EZ-series are single-drum all-in-one combos and its 'laundry center' listings are stackable two-piece sets — no unitized cabinet found as of 2026-08-07.

category_observations.observation: Category price band (Lowe's 'Stacked Laundry Centers'): typical price $1,878, range ~$1,298-$3,099; LG, GE, Whirlpool called most popular brands — i.e., Lowe's now counts WashTowers inside the laundry-center category.

Traditional 27-in centers cluster ~$1,300-$1,650 street: GE electric $1,398-1,549, Whirlpool gas $1,549 (was $1,888), Frigidaire long-vent $1,348-1,349.99; adjacent single-unit towers sit one tier up at $1,897-$2,799.

Discontinuations observed: Whirlpool WET4027EW discontinued (replaced by WET4027HW); WET4027HW 'temporarily out of stock' on whirlpool.com; GE GUD24ESSMWW and Frigidaire FLCE7523AW both 'no longer sold on Lowes.com' while active at HD/Best Buy.

Retail taxonomy has merged the segments: Home Depot titles the LG unit 'LG WashTower Stacked SMART Laundry Center'; Lowe's titles Samsung's unit 'Bespoke AI Laundry Hub Electric Stacked Laundry Center'.

Review-base asymmetry: legacy centers carry thousands of reviews (GE GUD27 4.2/2,114 HD; Whirlpool WET4024HW 4.3/2,224 HD; Frigidaire FLCE7522AW 4.3/2,611 Walmart) vs Samsung Hub 4.7/46 at Walmart; LG WashTower already 4.6/2,784 (Best Buy).

Editorial pressure: Reviewed's '6 Best Laundry Centers of 2026' puts Samsung Bespoke Hub and LG WashTower at the top of the laundry-center ranking, with GE/Whirlpool/Frigidaire unitized units positioned as budget picks.
